thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered PD-4859: high GPU memory pressure in us-west2a (pool-gamma). Severity: P1. Symptoms: repeated NVML OOMs, CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY / CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS on infer-host-09. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4859
jake_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Shifting traffic off pool-gamma and draining new requests.
maria_ops: seeing `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo` spikes and cgroups OOM -> logs: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` on model-serve-xyz. 420MB -> 1.8GB within seconds.
jake_oncall: starting node cordon+drain for host-09, triggering fallback routing to reserved-dedicated-1. Using: `kubectl cordon node/infer-09 && kubectl drain node/infer-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
ashley_reliability: FYI customer A's requests are showing 500/timeout ~1.2k requests in last 10m. I'm opening a support bridge.
dev_support: added temporary rate limit on embeddings route for affected region: `service-config set --route /v1/embeddings --rate 60rpm --region us-west2`
jake_oncall: Cordon done. Drain in progress. Evicted 5 pods, 7 still terminating — prefetch cache kv spikes noted.
sre_bot: autoscaler triggered +2 nodes in pool-alpha to absorb load, but pool-gamma still unhealthy.
maria_ops: collecting `nvidia-smi -q` from infer-09: Memory Usage: 15360 MiB, processes: tensor-runner (PID 2145) using 14600MiB. Suspect inference memory leak on this model variant.
ashley_reliability: contacting account team to warn customers; drafting blurb: "We are investigating increased GPU memory errors impacting a subset of requests in us-west2. Mitigation in progress."
jake_oncall: Escalating to ML-runtime oncall @ash (ashley_reliability) for model-level rollback. Can we flip to quantized variant v2-q1?
ashley_reliability: rolling model rollback now: `service-deploy rollback model:maker-7 v2-q1` — started.
maria_ops: rollback completed on 6 pods, nvml OOMs dropped on infer-09 trace, memory stable at ~2GB.
jake_oncall: marking PD incident acknowledged -> status: mitigated. Keeping PD open for follow-up and postmortem.
ashley_reliability: opening incident ticket INC-2026 and scheduling 30m postmortem. Action items: reproduce leak locally, add guardrails to autoscale thresholds, alert tuning.
dev_support: informed customers A,B,C on bridge. No customer data leaked.
jake_oncall: thanks all — leaving a note to revert rate-limit in 1h if stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PD-4859 acknowledged by jake_oncall at 1719201234
